headline: 9 killed in two-bus collision in Sylhet
summary: At least 25 others were injured in the head-on crash between a Dhaka-bound and a Sylhet-bound bus.
details: Nine people were killed in a devastating head-on collision between two passenger buses in Sylhet.
The accident involved a bus heading toward Dhaka and another heading toward Sylhet.
In addition to the fatalities, at least 25 people were injured in the crash.
The injured were rushed to the nearby hospital for emergency treatment.
The severity of the impact left both vehicles heavily damaged, as seen in images of the wreckage.

headline: Content creator Ripon Mia arrested over alleged rape of 15-year-old
summary: The suspect allegedly used his social media popularity to lure the victim and was previously 'settled' via village arbitration.
details: Content creator Ripon Mia was arrested early Friday morning by a Rab team in the Mohisharon Achintapur area of Netrokona. He is accused of raping a 15-year-old girl in Netrokona Sadar.

According to the case statement, Ripon and the victim were neighbors. He allegedly used his popularity as a content creator to make videos with the girl without her father's knowledge and lured her with promises of making her viral on social media.
The incident allegedly occurred around 8:00 pm on July 30, when Ripon called the victim to the Mogra River bank under the pretext of an urgent discussion and raped her.
Initially, local influentials settled the matter through a village arbitration, which fined Ripon Tk 5 lakh and ordered him to leave the area.
However, after a video of the arbitration meeting went viral on social media, police intervened. They brought the victim's family to the station on Tuesday and encouraged them to file a formal case.
The case was filed on August 5 under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000, leading to the suspect's arrest by Rab-14 Mymensingh Battalion.
caption:
A content creator allegedly used his social media fame to lure and rape a 15-year-old girl.

Content creator Ripon Mia was arrested early Friday morning by a Rab team in the Mohisharon Achintapur area of Netrokona. He is accused of raping a 15-year-old girl in Netrokona Sadar.

According to the case statement, Ripon and the victim were neighbors. He allegedly used his popularity as a content creator to make videos with the girl without her father's knowledge and lured her with promises of making her viral on social media.

The incident allegedly occurred around 8:00 pm on July 30, when Ripon called the victim to the Mogra River bank under the pretext of an urgent discussion and raped her.

Initially, local influentials settled the matter through a village arbitration, which fined Ripon Tk 5 lakh and ordered him to leave the area.

However, after a video of the arbitration meeting went viral on social media, police intervened. They brought the victim's family to the station on Tuesday and encouraged them to file a formal case.

The case was filed on August 5 under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act, 2000, leading to the suspect's arrest by Rab-14 Mymensingh Battalion.
